metadata.title: [Duplicate — see 10.5281/zenodo.24386242] 200,000 Indie Developer Checkout Links and Payment Platform Adoption Dataset (2023–2026)
metadata.description:
What changed in this version (version 2, 22 November 2026). This record is a duplicate, created by mistake on 20 November 2026 when the same upload ran twice; version 1 held the same files as 10.5281/zenodo.24386243. Version 1's figures are wrong. Its table did not match the report it came from (for example, Polar 180 / 1,100 / 2,400 new sellers in 2024 / 2025 / 2026, where the report gives 55 / 305 / 1,364), and it had a row for Waffo Pancake, for which the source has no data. This version removes those files and keeps only a note.

Use 10.5281/zenodo.24386242 instead ("New Sellers on Seven Checkout Platforms, 2023 to 15 October 2026: Summary Tables"); that DOI always points to the newest version of the corrected record. Please do not cite this record.
